legal.terms.title: Terms & Conditions
legal.terms.intro_body: By using Souq Al Arab EU, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
legal.terms.usage_body: You may use the platform only for lawful purposes and in compliance with local laws and platform policies.
legal.terms.account_body: You are responsible for your login credentials and all activity under your account, and you must keep your information accurate.
legal.terms.content_body: You are responsible for the accuracy of posted content, which must not be misleading, unlawful, or infringing others' rights.
legal.terms.transactions_body: The platform connects users. Buyers and sellers are responsible for arranging payment and delivery safely.
legal.terms.prohibited_body: Illegal, fraudulent, abusive, or policy-violating content is prohibited and may be removed without prior notice.
legal.terms.liability_body: We make reasonable efforts to keep the service reliable, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation at all times.
legal.terms.updates_body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after updates means you accept the revised terms.
legal.terms.contact_body: For legal questions or complaints, please contact us through the in-app support channels.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro_body: We respect your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data when you use the platform.
legal.privacy.collected_body: We may collect basic account data, contact information, content you post, and technical usage data.
legal.privacy.usage_body: We use data to operate the platform, improve services, provide support, and deliver a safer experience.
legal.privacy.sharing_body: We do not sell your personal data. Limited data may be shared when needed to run the service or meet legal obligations.
legal.privacy.security_body: We apply reasonable security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access or misuse.
legal.privacy.cookies_body: We may use cookies to improve performance, remember preferences, and analyze platform usage.
legal.privacy.retention_body: We retain data as long as necessary for operational or legal purposes, then delete or anonymize it according to policy.
legal.privacy.rights_body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data within applicable legal limits.
legal.privacy.contact_body: For privacy-related questions, contact us through the Help & Support page in the app.
